description:
Locate the visitor 'Margaret Chen' (Company: Nextera Consulting) in Jolly Lobby Track. If she is not already in the system, register her using the details provided in 'Visitor_Info.txt' on the desktop. 

Once the record is selected, generate a visitor badge. Since no physical printer is connected, you must 'Print to File' or 'Save as PDF'.

Save the badge output to '/home/ga/Documents/visitor_badge_output.pdf'. 

If PDF export is not possible, open the 'Print Preview' window showing her badge and take a screenshot of ONLY the preview window, saving it to '/home/ga/Documents/visitor_badge_preview.png'.
